signs.name: Stop
signs.detailedMeaning: You must make a full stop at the solid white limit line or before entering the crosswalk.
signs.commonMistake: Slowing down without coming to a complete cessation of movement (a 'rolling stop').

signs.name: Yield
signs.detailedMeaning: You must slow down and be ready to stop to let any vehicle, bicyclist, or pedestrian pass before you proceed.
signs.commonMistake: Failing to stop when other traffic is present.

signs.name: Do Not Enter
signs.shortMeaning: Do not drive in this direction.
signs.detailedMeaning: This road is restricted to traffic coming toward you.
signs.commonMistake: Thinking it only applies to commercial vehicles.

signs.name: Wrong Way
signs.detailedMeaning: Often paired with Do Not Enter signs. You must immediately pull over and turn around safely.

signs.name: Pedestrian Crossing
signs.detailedMeaning: Alerts you to a crosswalk or location where pedestrians often cross. Slow down and prepare to stop.
signs.commonMistake: Assuming pedestrians must yield to vehicles.

signs.name: Slippery When Wet
signs.shortMeaning: Road is slick in wet conditions.
signs.detailedMeaning: The road surface ahead reduces traction when wet. Slow down and avoid sudden braking or turning.

signs.name: Sharp Curve
signs.detailedMeaning: The road will curve sharply. You should slow down to the advised speed before entering the curve.
signs.commonMistake: Braking hard in the middle of the curve.

signs.name: Merge
signs.detailedMeaning: Traffic from another road will be merging into your lane. Be prepared to adjust your speed or change lanes.
signs.commonMistake: Refusing to allow merging traffic to enter.

signs.name: Hospital
signs.detailedMeaning: Directs drivers to a nearby hospital providing emergency medical services.
signs.commonMistake: Confusing it with a general rest stop.

signs.name: Route Marker
signs.detailedMeaning: Indicates the interstate route you are traveling on.
signs.commonMistake: Confusing it with a speed limit sign.

signs.name: Road Work Ahead
signs.detailedMeaning: Indicates upcoming road work. Slow down and be prepared for lane closures or workers.

signs.name: Flagger Ahead
signs.detailedMeaning: A person is directing traffic ahead. You must follow their instructions.
signs.commonMistake: Ignoring the flagger and following the regular traffic light.

signs.name: Railroad Crossing
signs.detailedMeaning: You are approaching a railroad crossing. Look, listen, and prepare to stop.
signs.commonMistake: Trying to beat a train across the tracks.

signs.name: Crossbuck
signs.detailedMeaning: Located exactly at the tracks. Always yield the right-of-way to approaching trains.

signs.name: No U-Turn
signs.detailedMeaning: You may not turn your vehicle around to travel in the opposite direction.
signs.commonMistake: Making a U-turn when the road seems clear.
